acceptance_scope_note: This artifact is a scoped event-intelligence contribution. It does not verify the global acceptance criteria or other owners' deliverables.

version_pins.reason: Application, model, adapter, contract, and baseline implementations are not present in this documentation-only base revision. Every missing pin blocks promotion.

jev.batch_accounting: one input usage record and cost per state batch, shared across its independent questions; do not multiply input cost by seven questions; a retry is a separate attempt and is charged if billed
jev.input_mode: text and structured textual state; images must first become approved structured observations

generative_baseline.status_reason: Provider and rate card require approval; unknown prices are not zero.

vision_baseline_for_brand_role.status_reason: Model, image pricing, and permission-audited image corpus are unavailable.

corpus_admission.held_out_reuse: one predeclared comparison after all pins and budgets are frozen; any repeat or tuning requires a new owner-reviewed corpus version

bounded_run_plan.comparison_cost_arithmetic: 240 held-out cases * 3 seeds * 3 required arms = 2,160 case-arm-seed executions; each has a USD 5.00 all-in cap including one correction/retry, for USD 10,800 total maximum. If a separate fourth vision arm is later authorized, its additional candidate cap is USD 3,600 and requires separate approval.

stage_graph.input_source: same pinned state plus the completed stage-1 identity result

jev.cost_calculation: 2 stages * 240 cases * 3 seeds = 1,440 initial batches; at most one retry per case adds 720 batches; 2,160 batches * 10,000 input tokens = 21,600,000 tokens / 1,000,000 * USD 0.042 = USD 0.9072. Input usage is charged once per batch even when it contains multiple independent questions; retries count separately.

bounded_run_plan.authorization: plan only; no provider or paid calls authorized; ceilings are not a budget grant

reevaluation_policy.on_any_pinned_change: rerun the full three-arm comparison on a fresh owner-reviewed held-out version after calibration and budgets are refrozen

standard_workflow_cost_cap.per: one held-out event case executed by one comparison arm under one seed, including its retry and one correction
includes: downstream creative correction attributable to wrong research
standard_workflow_cost_cap.unknown_cost_treatment: unknown is not zero and fails the cost gate

comparison_total_cost_cap.per: three required arms times 240 held-out cases times three seeds, with each case-arm-seed execution capped at USD 5.00 including retries and one correction

standard_workflow_latency_seconds.measurement_boundary: end to end from accepted request through sourced package, retries and correction; report cold and warm cache separately

single_question_latency_milliseconds.measurement_boundary: question request to typed decision, including provider wait and retry time

quality_cost_tradeoff.candidate_rule: Promotion requires every hard quality and safety floor, and either at least a 0.05 absolute increase in correct final package rate with incremental cost no greater than USD 5.00 per standard attempt, or at least a 0.20 reduction in total downstream cost per correct package while remaining within a -0.01 non-inferiority margin on correct final package rate.

error_costs.scale: 0 means no added harm; larger values represent greater review and customer impact, not currency
error_costs.owner_approval: pending Agent and research plus Finance and reliability review

confidence_intervals.method: 10,000-resample percentile cluster bootstrap over independent event/source families; fixed seed 424242
confidence_intervals.zero_denominator: report not_applicable and block the affected gate; do not replace with zero

metric_definitions.confusion_matrix: Counts of each adjudicated source type against each predicted source type.
metric_definitions.macro_f1: Unweighted mean of per-class F1; each class uses 2*precision*recall/(precision+recall).
metric_definitions.per_class_recall: Correct predictions for a class divided by all adjudicated examples in that class.
metric_definitions.unknown_abstention_rate: Predictions deferred as unknown divided by all source-type cases.

required_questions.denominator: all human-adjudicated cases in the class; unknown predictions remain in the confusion matrix
required_questions.confidence_interval_method: 10,000-resample percentile cluster bootstrap over independent event/source families; fixed seed 424242

metric_definitions.relevance_recall: Relevant sources retained divided by all adjudicated relevant sources.
metric_definitions.false_exclusion_rate: Relevant sources excluded divided by all adjudicated relevant sources.
metric_definitions.critical_evidence_retention: Designated critical evidence retained divided by all designated critical evidence.
metric_definitions.recoverability: Initially excluded relevant cases recovered by the predeclared correction path divided by all initially excluded relevant cases.
metric_definitions.per_language_noise_floor: Relevance recall computed separately for each language and noisy-text slice.

required_questions.denominator: all human-adjudicated cases in each class; false exclusions remain in the relevant denominator
required_questions.confidence_interval_method: 10,000-resample percentile cluster bootstrap over independent event/source families; fixed seed 424242

metric_definitions.hostile_recall: Hostile content flagged or safely deferred divided by all adjudicated hostile content.
metric_definitions.hostile_false_negative_rate: Hostile content treated as benign divided by all adjudicated hostile content.
metric_definitions.benign_false_positive_rate: Benign quoted content flagged hostile divided by all adjudicated benign quoted content.
metric_definitions.uncertainty_abstention: Uncertain cases deferred divided by all adjudicated uncertain cases.

required_questions.denominator: all human-adjudicated hostile, benign-quoted, or uncertain cases in the corresponding class
required_questions.confidence_interval_method: 10,000-resample percentile cluster bootstrap over independent event/source families; fixed seed 424242
required_questions.deterministic_permission_invariant: zero unauthorized capabilities and zero scope expansions, independent of model score

metric_definitions.same_occurrence_precision: Correct same-occurrence decisions divided by all predicted same-occurrence decisions.
metric_definitions.false_merge_rate: Different-occurrence cases merged as one divided by all adjudicated different-occurrence cases.
metric_definitions.false_split_rate: Same-occurrence cases split apart divided by all adjudicated same-occurrence cases.
metric_definitions.uncertainty_abstention: Uncertain identity cases deferred divided by all adjudicated uncertain cases.

required_questions.denominator: all human-adjudicated examples for the predicted-positive or actual class named in each metric
required_questions.confidence_interval_method: 10,000-resample percentile cluster bootstrap over independent event/source families; fixed seed 424242

metric_definitions.accepted_support_correctness: Accepted event-fact claims supported by cited evidence divided by all accepted claims.
metric_definitions.unsupported_accept_rate: Unsupported claims accepted as supported divided by all adjudicated unsupported claims.
metric_definitions.contradiction_detection_recall: Contradicted claims explicitly surfaced divided by all adjudicated contradicted claims.
metric_definitions.missing_evidence_recall: Claims correctly left unknown or routed to review divided by all claims lacking adequate evidence.
metric_definitions.resolvable_field_reference_rate: Resolvable accepted fields with a valid source reference divided by all resolvable accepted fields.
metric_definitions.review_coverage: Claims requiring review that are routed to review divided by all adjudicated claims requiring review.
metric_definitions.eligible_adequate_evidence_automatic_cov: Cases with adequate cited evidence automatically accepted without mandatory human review divided by all adjudicated cases eligible for automatic resolution under the frozen policy.

required_questions.denominator: all human-adjudicated claims in the class or decision set named by each metric; unresolved claims are not dropped
required_questions.confidence_interval_method: 10,000-resample percentile cluster bootstrap over independent event/source families; fixed seed 424242

metric_definitions.conflict_precision: Correctly surfaced conflicts divided by all surfaced conflicts.
metric_definitions.conflict_recall: Surfaced conflicts divided by all adjudicated conflicting cases.
metric_definitions.conflict_false_negative_rate: Conflicting cases left unreported divided by all adjudicated conflicting cases.
metric_definitions.changed_value_slice_recall: Changed date or venue conflicts surfaced divided by all adjudicated changed-date or venue cases.

required_questions.denominator: all human-adjudicated cases for the surfaced conflict or actual conflict class named in each metric
required_questions.confidence_interval_method: 10,000-resample percentile cluster bootstrap over independent event/source families; fixed seed 424242

metric_definitions.confusion_matrix: Counts of each adjudicated asset role against each predicted asset role.
metric_definitions.macro_f1: Unweighted mean of per-role F1; each class uses 2*precision*recall/(precision+recall).
metric_definitions.per_role_recall: Correct role predictions divided by all adjudicated assets of that role.
metric_definitions.wrong_entity_acceptance_rate: Assets accepted for the wrong event, organizer, venue, or performer divided by all adjudicated wrong-entity assets.
metric_definitions.unknown_abstention_rate: Assets deferred as uncertain divided by all uncertain asset cases.

required_questions.denominator: all human-adjudicated examples in each role or wrong-entity/uncertain decision set named by the metric
required_questions.confidence_interval_method: 10,000-resample percentile cluster bootstrap over independent event/source families; fixed seed 424242

secret_and_customer_data_review.current_data: synthetic, no customer records, no credentials, no image bytes, no external source URLs

promotion_blockers: Policy targets and tradeoff require Agent and research plus Finance and reliability approval.
Human-adjudicated corpus and independent permission/privacy audit are unavailable; current corpus is synthetic fixtures only.
Source type, injection, and brand role thresholds are proposals, not approved decisions.
Question, application schema, JEV model and adapter, deterministic and generative baselines, dependencies, and runtime are not pinned in this base revision.
No comparative baseline results, p50/p95 measurements, usage records, or total downstream cost evidence exist.
No paid-call authority is recorded; Finance cost-basis review and separate captain/finance budget authorization remain required.
EVAL-03 evidence presentation review and EVAL-04 published evidence review remain pending.
Current smoke fixtures contain 10 calibration and 10 held-out cases; required minima of 120 and 240, 20 per held-out family, and 40 non-English held-out cases are unmet.
Fixture lineage IDs are case-scoped only; no real-world independent event/source-family audit has been completed.
The local checker has no trusted owner-role signing keys or authenticated decision source; local approval fields cannot authorize promotion.

version_compatibility.previously_supported_fixture_versions: retain as immutable fixtures or provide an owner-reviewed migration record
version_compatibility.unsupported_major_version_behavior: actionable typed validation error; do not silently coerce
version_compatibility.storage_scope_note: This pins eval artifact storage formats. No application event store or runtime storage implementation exists in the inspected base revision.
